## About
Precision Auto Service Center is a local, family-owned and operated shop in West Chester. One reviewer tells it simply: it's owned and run by a husband and wife, and Brenda Burger is the general manager.
We started this place because we hated the high-pressure sales tactics and the unneeded services we got pushed on when we were younger. So we explain your car in plain terms, show you the work that needs doing, and help you prioritize instead of telling you everything has to happen today.
Our focus is doing it right the first time and keeping your car on the road through mileage maintenance. Neighbors have rated us 4.9 from 411 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours.

## Services
- Brakes: Brake pads, shoes, rotors, drums, calipers, master cylinders and anti lock brake systems.
- Oil Changes: Oil changes plus fluid services for antifreeze, transmission, brakes, differential, transfer case and power steering. A dollar of every oil change goes to St. Jude Children's Hospital.
- Tires: All brands and sizes, installation, rotation, computerized wheel balancing, flat repair, TPMS sensors and wheel alignment.
- Air Conditioning: Air conditioning and heating repair so the car is comfortable again.
- Mufflers: Mufflers, catalytic converters, tail pipes, resonators, flex pipe, hangers and welding.
- Check Engine Lights: We track down what's behind the light and show you the part we replaced.
- Fuel Pumps: Fuel pumps, injectors, filters, tanks and throttle body work.
- Maintenance & Tune-Ups: Scheduled maintenance to keep your car reliable and keep your costs down over the life of the vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30AM - 5:30PM.

Q: Where exactly is the shop?
A: At the intersection of Princeton Glendale Rd and Rialto Rd in West Chester.

Q: Can you help if my car breaks down unexpectedly?
A: Yes. We handle emergency auto service as well as scheduled vehicle maintenance. Give us a call.

Q: Who works on my car?
A: Our ASE Certified Technicians handle a wide variety of repairs, and Brenda at the front desk keeps you informed along the way.
